name: FM 2 Cards
author: FM 2
description: FM 2 cards: the Ember, Tide and Grove lines, new cards built to be fused from weak cards into strong ones. Placeholder artwork (gradient + tier dots) until the final art is made.

cards.name: Pebble Raptor
cards.description:
A small raptor that
nests in warm ash
and cracked stone.

cards.name: Spark Beetle
cards.description:
Its wings leave a
trail of sparks. It
is the seed of the
Ember line.

cards.name: Ash Sparrow
cards.description:
Born from the embers
of a dead volcano.

cards.name: Ember Kindler
cards.description:
{f8 0A 05}<Aura>{f8 0A 00} Your other
FIRE monsters get
+200 ATK.
Fusion: Ash Sparrow
+ Pebble Raptor

cards.name: Ashfeather Hawk
cards.description:
Fusion: Ash Sparrow
+ Spark Beetle

cards.name: Magma Raptor
cards.description:
Fusion: Pebble Raptor
+ Spark Beetle

cards.name: Blazing Wyvern
cards.description:
Fusion: Ashfeather
Hawk + Magma Raptor

cards.name: Obsidian Colossus
cards.description:
Fusion: Magma
Raptor + Ember
Kindler

cards.name: Caldera Drake
cards.description:
{f8 0A 05}<Destroyed>{f8 0A 00} Deals 600
damage to the opponent.
Fusion: Blazing
Wyvern + Obsidian
Colossus

cards.name: Solar Phoenix Dragon
cards.description:
{f8 0A 05}<Aura>{f8 0A 00} Your other
FIRE monsters get
+300 ATK and DEF.
{f8 0A 05}<Destroyed>{f8 0A 00} Deals
800 damage.
Fusion: Caldera Drake
+ Crimson Sunbird

cards.name: Foam Sprite
cards.description:
A shy spirit made of
sea foam. It pops
when it laughs.

cards.name: Reef Crab
cards.description:
Its shell is built
from coral and
stubbornness.

cards.name: Brine Eel
cards.description:
It hunts in the dark
water under the reef.

cards.name: Tide Priestess
cards.description:
{f8 0A 05}<Draw>{f8 0A 00} Restores 300 LP at
the start of your turn.
Fusion: Foam Sprite
+ Reef Crab

cards.name: Coral Guardian
cards.description:
Fusion: Reef Crab
+ Brine Eel

cards.name: Razor Barracuda
cards.description:
Fusion: Brine Eel
+ Foam Sprite

cards.name: Deepwater Serpent
cards.description:
Fusion: Razor
Barracuda + Brine Eel

cards.name: Abyssal Nautilus
cards.description:

cards.name: Tidal Leviathan
cards.description:
{f8 0A 05}<Battle>{f8 0A 00} The monster it

Serpent + Abyssal
Nautilus

cards.description:

when it destroys a
monster.
Fusion: Abyssal
Nautilus + Giant Red
Seasnake

cards.name: Leaf Grub
cards.description:
It eats one leaf a
day and dreams of
wings.

cards.name: Thorn Sprout
cards.description:
A seedling armed
with tiny thorns.

cards.name: Mossback Beetle
cards.description:
Moss grows on its
back, so the forest
hides it well.
